notes: Zoning layers, queried live, and how each jurisdiction's zones answer AB 2011's first site test: is the site 'in a zone where office, retail, or parking are a principally permitted use' (Gov. Code §§ 65912.111(a), 65912.121(a))?

'Principally permitted use' = a use that may occupy more than one-third of the square footage on the site without a conditional use permit; parking uses count whether or not they need a CUP (§ 65912.101(u)).

Each source lists rules, tried in order: a regular expression on the zone code (or on the city's own zone category) and the class of zone it denotes. Classes carry the status; a rule may override it. A city's own layer is used before a regional compilation.

commercial.label: Commercial zone
commercial.why: Retail and office uses are permitted by right in this jurisdiction's commercial zones.

office.label: Office zone
office.why: Office uses are permitted by right in this zone.

parking.label: Parking zone
parking.why: Parking is the zone's purpose, and parking uses are principally permitted even where a conditional use permit is required (§ 65912.101(u)).

mixed-commercial.label: Commercial or employment mixed-use zone
mixed-commercial.why: Retail and office uses are permitted by right without a floor-area cap.

mixed-residential.label: Residential-led mixed-use zone
mixed-residential.why: Commercial uses are permitted, but often only on the ground floor or as a share of floor area; whether office or retail may exceed one-third of the square footage depends on the zone's standards.

industrial.label: Industrial zone
industrial.why: Industrial zones often permit office or parking uses (parking counts even with a conditional use permit); check the zone's use table. Note AB 2011's separate industrial-use tests (§§ 65912.111(d), 65912.121(f)).

residential.label: Residential zone
residential.why: Residential zones do not permit office or retail uses, and parking is allowed only as accessory to the homes. If this jurisdiction's code permits a parking use in this zone, even with a conditional use permit, the site would qualify (§ 65912.101(u)).

public.label: Public or institutional zone
public.why: Public facility zones sometimes permit public parking or offices; check the zone's use table.

planned.label: Planned development or specific plan district
planned.why: Permitted uses are set by the district's own ordinance or plan, not the base zoning code.

open-space.label: Open space or park zone
open-space.why: Open space zones do not permit office, retail, or parking uses.

agriculture.label: Agricultural zone
agriculture.why: Agricultural zones do not permit office or retail uses.

transportation.label: Transportation or right-of-way zone
transportation.why: Freeway, railroad, and right-of-way zones are not development sites.

unknown.label: Zone not classified
unknown.why: This zone code is not in the site's rule table; check the jurisdiction's zoning code.
